user.title: Connect Okilou
user.description: Create a household token in the Okilou app: Settings → Your household → API & home automation. The token is read-only and can be revoked anytime from the app.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Okilou
reauth_confirm.description: The token was revoked or is invalid. Create a new one in the Okilou app (Settings → Your household → API & home automation) and paste it here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Okilou API
